title: Machi Koro-style round category icon — коробка ПВЗ
purpose: Small circular category badge for the blue ПВЗ card.

integration_context.target_use: Generate only the icon asset for card compositing.
integration_context.background: Native RGBA transparency outside the circular badge.
integration_context.output_preference: RGBA PNG with clean antialiased edges

pictogram.subject: closed shipping box
pictogram.description: A bold pure-white cubic parcel box in a slight three-quarter view, with a visible top plane, front face, narrow side face, and one broad dark-blue packing-tape stripe running across the lid and down the front. Use only a few thick dark-blue negative-space separations. The silhouette must read immediately as a sturdy shipping box rather than a card, envelope or application tile.

anti_patterns: no location pin, letters, digits, words, logos, barcodes or labels
no gradients, highlights, texture, shadow, bevel or 3D
no opaque background outside the circle
final_prompt_summary: Use case: logo-brand. Generate only one small Machi Koro-style category badge on a square canvas. Create one centered blue circular badge with native RGBA transparency outside it. Inside, place a bold pure-white closed shipping box in a slight three-quarter view: visible top lid plane, front face, narrow side face, and one broad dark-blue packing-tape stripe crossing the top and running down the front. Use only a few thick negative-space separations. The pictogram must read instantly as a sturdy parcel box, not a card, envelope or app tile. No location pin, outer ring, text, letters, digits, logos, barcode, address label, ribbon, scenery or card furniture.
